title: OpenAI and Target team up on new AI-powered experiences
summary: OpenAI and Target are partnering to bring a new Target app to ChatGPT, offering personalized shopping and faster checkout. Target will also expand its use of ChatGPT Enterprise to boost productivity and guest experiences.
body: OpenAI and Target are partnering to bring a new Target app to ChatGPT, offering personalized shopping and faster checkout. Target will also expand its use of ChatGPT Enterprise to boost productivity and guest experiences.
summaryZh: OpenAI与Target达成合作，将推出集成于ChatGPT的新型购物体验，支持个性化推荐与快速结账。同时，Target将扩大ChatGPT Enterprise的使用范围，以提升内部生产力与客户服务体验。此次合作是大型零售企业深度应用生成式AI的典型案例，展示了模型在提升商业运营效率与用户交互体验方面的实际价值。
